written: 2026-11-05: v3.1's rules unchanged on six new descriptors (boleSway and leanAngle added the same day); d_min and the upper end frozen at v3.1's; written from real QSMs only, before any simulated tree is read

rules.datasets_note: oak is gated at Wytham only (the user, 2026-11-03): BioDiv has no oaks, so no control can set an oak d_min there; v1 gated oak at BioDiv's beech resolution and failed it there (×1: 7 of 19). Demol is beech's held-out site (the 1d brief, 4): its control curve is reported, never gated
rules.coarsen: prune only (v3): every cylinder under d_min goes with its subtree; the re-cut of v1 and v2 is withdrawn (coarsen.py)
rules.describe: every segment-length-dependent descriptor at the fixed 0.5 m step on both sides (droop, upturn, branchAngle2 as 0.5 m chords; tortuosity05, limbElevation05, pendulousFraction05 resampled at 0.5 m); tortuosity, limbElevation and pendulousFraction (per cylinder) report-only
rules.beech_estimator: a tree's descriptor is the median over its 5 repeats of the optimum's input set (finite values; NaN under 3), for the tolerance, the floor and the control alike; Wytham's and Demol's trees are single-model (only 12 Wytham trees have 10 models)
rules.floor: oak, maple: the RMS over Wytham's noise trees of the SD across 10 models; beech: the RMS over BioDiv's trees of the SD across its 5 repeats, / √5 (the SD of a median-of-repeats value), against the between-tree SD of the medians. Hold-out at >= 0.5 × the between-tree SD: reported as noise-limited at that dataset
rules.d_min: per dataset, the largest point of the grid (the [1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50] percentiles of its pooled terminal raw diameters) at which, for every gated species of the dataset, >= 90% of its gated descriptors have >= 90% of its real trees within tolerance after coarsen() (control.py). Gated: not report-only, not H1-excluded, not held out by the noise floor. A NaN original leaves the tree; a NaN after coarsening is outside. No point passes: the dataset stops. The bracket ×0.5/×2 is withdrawn

stress.source: Demol et al. 2022, Silva Fennica 56(1) 10550: branches under ≈ 5 cm carry 80–83% of the QSM volume overestimate (Table 3); the completeness threshold the 1d brief names

rules.inflation: Demol et al. 2022 (§3.2, Table 3): diameter +73% under 2.5 cm, +4% over 10 cm, log-interpolated between (not measured). Gated at d_min for both tiers (the user, 2026-11-03). Order: inflate, prune
rules.evaluation_points: v3.1 (the user, 2026-11-03, from the control curves): d_min, every grid point strictly inside (d_min, upper), the upper end, and inflation at d_min (tiers.evaluation_points). The upper end is the first grid point above d_min at which the dataset's control fails (tiers.upper_end): Wytham 12.1 mm (p50), BioDiv 11.0 mm (p5). Set after seeing the control curves, by the criterion 'first failing grid point' and not a chosen width; no simulated value entered. v3 had [d_min, 2·d_min]
rules.tier_a: resolution-independent: per seed, the median over the stand's live measured trees of the signed describe(coarsen(tree)) − describe(tree); |median| <= tolerance on >= 15 of the 20 seeds at every evaluation point (tiers.tier_a)
rules.tier_b: valid at matched resolution: per seed, the median of the signed v(p) − v(d_min); |median| <= tolerance on >= 15 of the 20 seeds at every other evaluation point of [d_min, upper], inflation against v(d_min); and the descriptor's control neutral at d_min (>= 90% of real trees within tolerance) (tiers.tier_b)
rules.assign: A if tier A passes, else B if tier B passes, else held out (tiers.assign). Both tiers are targets; the fit always compares the coarsened simulator against the real QSMs, never fine simulated values
rules.fail: a seed with no live measured tree, or a NaN difference on any tree, fails that seed
rules.held_out: noise floor >= 0.5 × between-tree SD (noise-limited at the dataset), fewer than MIN_TREES finite real trees, or neither tier passes (resolution-sensitive). Report-only and H1-excluded descriptors are neither targets nor hold-outs
rules.survive: amendment E applies to the coarsening test (v3, the user): per species, over its descriptors that pass the floor (gated, clear): if fewer than half reach a tier, stop and report; never loosen. Floor hold-outs are reported as noise-limited at that dataset

size_match.reference: the median measured DBH of the species' tolerance set (R2): oak Wytham's DBH_pts, maple Wytham's sycamores' DBH_pts, beech BioDiv's dTLS (the user, 2026-11-03, extending the 1d brief's 4); values in `reference_dbh`
size_match.simulated: the converter's DBH (describe()'s, cylinders.py's rule) on the uncoarsened live measured trees
size_match.stand: the first season of stand_seasons at which the median over seeds 1–20 of the per-seed median DBH of the stand's live measured trees reaches the reference median. None by 300 (a compute bound): report and stop
size_match.lone: the same on the lone tree's DBH, at seasons 50–100 by 10. Not reached by 100: read at 100 and report the shortfall
size_match.report: the median height at the chosen season, beside the reference's

rules.control: every gated species' real QSMs of each dataset coarsened at each grid point and at the stress point; TreeML's 3 optcsv trees' shifts at each d_min reported with no verdict (phase 7's)

why.boleSway: the user's ruling, 2026-11-05: bole sway as a descriptor
why.leanAngle: the user's ruling, 2026-11-05 (the lean audit, ADR 0054): the bole's lean below crownBase80 as a descriptor; simulated tiers wait for the re-run
